{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Display basic information
trial_df.info()

# Display first few rows
display(trial_df.head())

# Check for missing values
missing_values = trial_df.isnull().sum()
print("Missing values per column:")
print(missing_values)

# Check for duplicates
duplicates = trial_df.duplicated().sum()
print(f"\nNumber of duplicate rows: {duplicates}")

# Show unique values in key columns
print("\nUnique values in 'arm':")
print(trial_df['arm'].unique())

print("\nUnique values in 'biomarker':")
print(trial_df['biomarker'].unique())

# Show distribution of biomarker
print("\nBiomarker summary statistics:")
print(trial_df['biomarker'].describe())"}
